rule: Six major statuses (brn, par, slp, frz, psn, tox) are exclusive per Pokemon: the normal move path routes through trySetStatus, which refuses a second major status. Volatiles are keyed by id; a volatile with no restart hook is refused while present, so the first application keeps its timer (confusion). Durations are turn counters decremented on the Residual event; random(m, n) is half-open. Residual order sets the tick sequence (poison and tox at 9, burn at 10). Paralysis is a 1-in-4 cannot-move roll with speed at half unless Quick Feet. Frozen thaws on a 1-in-5 roll per turn, on a fire hit, or by a defrost move. Burn halves physical damage. Tox adds one stage per residual, capped at 15. Stat stages clamp to -6..+6 with a fixed multiplier table. Immunities are per-ability and per-terrain hooks, not a central table. Synchronize reflects a status back to its source except sleep and freeze.

data_fields.name: volatile_restart_policy
data_fields.donor_value_or_null: refuse for confusion, restart for locked move

data_fields.name: status_end_time
data_fields.unit: server timestamp (not in donor; add for Frankendom)

keep: One major status at a time per target (exclusivity through the status setter)
First-wins volatiles: a present confusion keeps its timer
Escalating tox counter with a stage cap and a reset on switch-in
One-in-four skip plus halved speed as a readable stun
Stat stages clamped at -6 and +6 with a fixed multiplier table
Terrain as a grounded-only immunity tag on the zone
Immunity as per-ability hooks, one or two per character
change: Donor is turn-based: convert turn counters to ms or to our tick
Donor sends no time-left value to the client; Frankendom should send status end time
Donor has no DoT stacking per attacker; Frankendom sets the stack cap to 3 (max attackers)
Donor has no animation or sound; the 5-minute look test must be built from scratch
Do not reuse the donor's battle-log wording
look_test: Text beat strip at 375 wide under the target, one line per beat. A: donor-style line for a paralysis skip ('X is paralyzed; it cannot move') staying 1 s. B: the same event as a short badge plus a skipped-action tick on the unit card, no text. Show a paralysis skip, then a tox counter 1, 2, 3. Dom judges which is readable in one second mid-fight at 375 wide. Use our own wording.
